centuries.moved: Silver did not yet move from the Americas; pepper reached Lisbon round the Cape from 1499; the printing press was fifty years old.

events.t: Three ships leave Palos on 3 August 1492, water at La Gomera, make landfall on 12 October and return to Lisbon in March 1493.
